Photo 2 cab bears a 'UD' badge on the grille, consistent with Nissan Diesel/UD truck lineage.
Windscreen has a hand-written or printed note reading something like 'Best Pads steering, No hand signal' – meaning unclear, likely an informal handling note.
Orange mast has a partially visible logo 'FR' or similar on the beam (photo 0/1) but not fully legible.
Visible rust streaks on the mast, cab roof, and chassis; dust and grime on windows and cab (photos 0-2).

No people or video of the engine/rig running in any photo.

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running, including drill rig operation (mast raise/lower, rotary head spin).
Clear photo of hour-meter or odometer reading.
Close-up photos of mast welds, hydraulic cylinders, and chassis frame without dust/rust obscuring them.
Photo of vehicle registration documents and current license.
Full equipment inventory photo (compressor, drill rods, tool kit) to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a Nissan Diesel/UD chassis, but no operational proof (engine running, drill functioning) is provided, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-functional, heavily weathered rig pending further verification.
